S.FORM: == Ging adingu 銀魂 == kakamuen劇情大綱 Ci-hu zitay nu amahedek, panganganan u "tapuku tademaw" "あまんと", nu caay kaw kakatinengan nu tapukuwan bunac a nipidebungan, tademaw atu tapukuwan a tademaw nika malepacaw tu nikabakuhac, hatidaay tu nu sikakapetan nanay a tademaw atu makayay nu duma a binacadan nu masakaputay milabu malepacaw. ci Mu-hu makatapal tu hatidaay nu icelang nina Ten-zen, baung satu, ales han tu nida ku sakapet, masasulit atu Ten-zen tu kiyaku, hang satu pacumud tu nu henian. satu pabeli tu " sapialesen tu takini'" a cudadan, sisa mapawan tu kina idaway nu sisakapetay a tademaw hicaen hakiya nu udip a milalebu. namakayda, ci Mu-hu lawaen ni Te-hu, mala "putiangan", hida satu a inayi' ku laheci, masakaputay atu makatalay hida satu a malawlaw ku balucu'. . mahiniay a zitayan, cacay u miliwanay tu kakapetan nanay nu tatamaan ci Pan-ten-in-se atu cabay ci Ce'-cun-sin-pa, Sen-le idaw ku nipisiwbayan nu heni tu Wan-se-u, idaw ku nisepian tu sademiad sananay nu lipahakay a nikaudipan. . nipiadih tu kitakid 世界觀 nikuda nina ka kungkuan itida i nipatidengan i Dipun nu Cin-hu-mu-hu nidudan tu nu Cin-hu-cen, itini i kakungkuan u "Ta- Cin-hu", u namakaydaay i tapukuwan nu bunacan a tademaw " Ten-zen" "あまんと" anikabahal sananay a tahekalay, miyiwkiw tu Dipun mibuhat tu kanatal, sisa ci Cin-hu kasenun satu mala aydaay a bunacan nu nayi' ay nisimsiman a kitakidan. "Ta-cin-hu" taneng a hidaen a musakamu, cacayay namaka Cin-hu-mu-hu kasenus sa taydan i bunabunacan nu zitay a Tu-kiwan, sisa itini i sabaw siwa nu secian nu Dipun a kakalingatuan, mipulung tu tusa a bataan nu aydaay nu zitayan, atu anuayaw nu mahicahicaay a kulikulitan nu nisimsiman, mala micidekay nu kawawan. duma satu nipicumudan ni Ten-zen tatenga milihida tu tayaay nu likisian ci De-cun-mu-hu nani sawacuan nu hekalay a nipidebungan nu micaliw tina kawawan tu sapadeng nu imian. . itini i " Gin adingu" nu Ta-cin-hu kitakidan, nikaitida sa i Cin-hu a makaadih tu dikuc nu Dipun, makaaidh tu mapungecay nu bukes a tatamaan, saysayen tu daw-ten-cu nu tataynaan nu bukesan, tanayu'ay nu kilang a nisangaan tu luma', sisakapetay tu katini'an, pana' a tademaw, u sapihemhem a zitay nu gagikian a micidekay nu hekahekalan, malecad a tahekal ku muo-ten-ta-luo, tilibi, tennaw, kadideng, dingwa aydaay a keci, atu tapukuan bunac a tademaw, mibahelay tayda i tapukuwan nu balungan, atu nisangaan tu tademaw atu kakatahekalan tu kitidaday nu sasimsimen nanay gikian. ina ka kungkuan caay ka tahekal kina Min-ce-wi-si nu sin-cen'-cun. ni De-cun-mu-hu a kawawan, tatengan ci Mu-hu sakakaay u sasalamaan ni "Ten-zen" " hekalay bunac tademaw" ku misalamaay ci nidaan, tawyaay nu sinikapetan nanay a tademaw mahida u mahedekay nu likisian, kenisan u midiputay tu Mu-hu nu icelangay, atu mibelinay tu Mu-hu nu makaiay tu kaput nu cekun. 在"銀魂" . sakay hekal a nicudadan 外傳作品 tulu mihcaan z kaputan Ging walu singsi "さんねんズィーぐみ ぎんぱちせんせい" 3年Z班銀八老師 Ging adingu tulu mihcaan z kaputan Ging walu singsi 銀魂 3年Z班銀八老師 "Ging adingu tulu mihcaan z kaputan Ging walu singsi" milawilaway tu Dipun cen-ci cacudadan nu gagikian " tulu mihcaan B kaput Cin-pa singsi", naitida tu i " ce'-wan JUMP" kina tusa a tahekal. ci Ging nikasidikucan " Ging pa singsi" simigani, sidikuc tu salengacay a dikucan, inuayaw nu takal a pasubana' mitabaku tu, u nayi'ay a imin ku sasakamuen. itini i mutiyungay nu gikian ci Ging walu singsi caay kaw tabaku ku tabakuan u piyang ku mulmulen. amilik ku nipinacnac ni Ging walu singsi tu piyeng sisa siwacah kiya laway. tahekalay nu kaputan nu "Ging adigu" a tademaw " Sin-walu, Sen-le', A-meawm, Cin-ten, Tu-hun, Cung-ten, Kuy, Cen-ku-cun tademawan", mikuliay a tadeamaw u duma a tademawan " Ye-yun, Cin-cen, Pa-lang wina". "3年Z "3年B組金八老師",曾在"赤丸JUMP" . kin adingu 金魂 ci Pan-ten-in-se masumad lukuten nida ku bekes malakimkimkiman nu malukutay nu bukesan, u dikuc nu kulitan atu ci In-se masasubelis, kapah ku wayway, kanamuhan nu misalukiyaway a tademaw pangangan han " Pan-ten-cin-se" nu tatamaan. nika hidasa, u cabay ni In-se namin, inayi' tu namin i tangah nida, ci Pan-ten-cin-se tu. tatusa kina caayay kapawan ci nidaan. makayda ni sakamuan ni Siaw-yi sisa matineng, hina lakalak mukan tu pah ci In-se. nika mahiniay a kikayan milawpes tu punu' nu katuuday mipawan ci In-sean. sisa mangalay miala tu aenengan nu cu-ciaw, ci In-se aci kin-se malingatu a malepacaw. sadikuday mapahemek ni In-se, paytem satu a taluma' patideng. kakungkuan 劇情 De-cun-mu-hu nu pihedekan, namaka tapukuan nanay nu tademaw tasasa, ci Cin-hu u nuheni tu ku kuwanan nu heni. tunikaydaan, ina tenzen wenmin tada malahat tu, nu matatungduhay nu lumaan, sidingkiay nu kadideng atu dingdingwa mamin nima i patiyamay. mahini ku aydaay a tukay, kalasiyansiyanan nanay, nika icelang ku udip, si pakuntaway nu udipan ci Pan-ten-in-se, misiwbay tu sapatudutan a kawaw nu luma'an. itini i kaidawan tu duhepicay nu Ce-cun-sin-pa aci Ye-tu-cu nu maudipay henay midatukay tu nipilawaan, ina luma' yadah ku lawilaw atu kalibutan nu dimiadan. kasikawawan mahicaay nu kawawan, ci In-se mapati'ti' i pungkan tahekal tu aydaay nu limaay nu kitakidan. inu ayawan nanay nida a tahekalay u sibaydukay nu " salengacay nu nipitupelisan" nanitupelisan mahida tu u nikaiyan nu luma'an. pakuyuc ku binacadan tanu adada'sa nu imelang, milawilaway nu tademaw mikiyaku pasayda i sihu patideng tu sapihantay tu patay, mapatay nu lawilaw ku syakay. i mahini, ahicanan naca sa ci In-se taydan nida kina tatusaay nu masakapahay, cacay han u tanektekay nu malakapahay a masakapahay nu simigamiay nu siningan, cacay han idaw ku nipiladay tu tabakiay nu salengacay nu wacuan bangcal ku nikasidikuc nayi' ku aykiway nu bangcalay a tatayna, alaw u balakiay tu ku nuheni ci Sin-pa aci Sen-le'!caay palutatengan ci In-hu, alaw itini i mata nida idaw ku nipikihulan tu ngangan nida i lunem! namahica tu limaay a mihcaan nu kawawan? ahicaen a misumad kina i nayi'ay nu Ging sean, du'ut sa atu kakatalawan nu kakataynian? ? katahekalan nu tademaw 登場角色 nu hicanan hakiya a icelangan tengtengen patayda i nayi'ay nu limaay a mihcaan nu kitakidan, makaadih tu nalimaay nu mihcaan a nikapatayan, kabiyalawan sa maala nu limaay a mihcaan ci Sin walu aci Sen-le', itida i pahikukian makaadih tu limaay a mihcaan nu udipan, sa matineng tu kakawaw, itida i sabaw lima nu mihcaan namidemec tu kawaw nu di'tu' malalid tu salengacay, hida satu mala di'tu, mademec tu nu udip, naayaway aku mutikuaca taluma tu sabaw lima nu mihcaan, atu wanseu a tademawan midemec tu di'tuan. . sasakamuen 用語 tatelungan kina Cin-hu sapatahekal i kitakid nu sapipatay tu tademaw a baydukan, caay ka tinengi ku bayduk atu kalalidan, limaay a mihcaan sa ina kitakid malawpes tu. malaliday i tini i pakiw nu buladan mapatay tu, hamin nu udiudipan salengac satu ku bukes lawpes ku lumeniay hida satu a salengac, nu caayay ka lalid a tademaw yada tu amin a milaliw, nu siidaay a tademaw idaw ku lahici a milaliw, u pakuyucay satu ku itiniay, babalaki ci nida tu ku maudipay ci nida tu ku mipatayay, sisa ina kitakid tulu a pasintu ku mapatayay, sepat a tademaw taydan i dumaan nu bunacan malimad nu kabiyalawan, mahida milecaday tu di'tu "mitimaay". .
